basal LiteRT %1$s

An unofficial Android app for the basal-2.0 typed-decision models, run with Google LiteRT on the phone's CPU or, on Snapdragon chips with compiled files, its NPU. Nothing you type leaves the phone.

Models: basal-2.0 by Remigiusz Kinas (github.com/rkinas/basal), Apache-2.0, fine-tuned from Bielik v3 (SpeakLeash, ACK Cyfronet AGH), Apache-2.0. Not affiliated with or endorsed by their authors.

Runtime: LiteRT (Google), Apache-2.0. App: Jetpack Compose, AndroidX, Kotlin, Apache-2.0.

Source code and the conversion scripts: github.com/kgonia/basal-android
